headings.description: Adhering to brand constraints, using Inter but with tight tracking and distinct weights to avoid a generic feel.

receipt_preview.font_family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace
receipt_preview.description: Essential for the thermal receipt preview. Needs to feel exactly like a physical dot-matrix/thermal printout.

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm on resting cards. The receipt preview needs a distinct shadow: shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)] to pop off the grey backdrop.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB (border color constraint) for structural dividers and cards.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-lg (8px) for cards, rounded-md (6px) for inner elements and inputs.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat, solid colors. No muddy glassmorphism. Data-dense settings require crisp, opaque surfaces. The active tab uses white background with subtle shadow on a #F3F4F6 container.

grids_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Compact yet structured. Use p-4 to p-6 inside cards. The tab bar uses px-6 py-2.
grids_and_spacing.tab_1_layout: Top section: 3-column grid for Printing Mode radio cards (Fixed / Waiter / Station). Below: list of printers. Inline form pushes content down (no modal overlay).
grids_and_spacing.inline_form_grid: Grid with 2 columns (md:grid-cols-2) for form inputs, but spanning full width for connection type cards (3-col grid: USB, LAN, BLE).
grids_and_spacing.tab_5_mapping_layout: Rows per printer. Each row uses flexbox: Left side printer name/details, Right side employee name-chips wrapping and 'Edit Assignments' trigger.
grids_and_spacing.tab_6_stations_layout: Data table or structured list format. Inline add/edit form row appearing directly in the list.

layouts.container: A 6-tab navigation container (PrinterAgentConfigView) residing inside a settings slide-over. Must feel cohesive and incredibly dense yet readable.
layouts.split_panel: Tab 4 (Print Style) -> Left: flex-1 for scrolling settings. Right: flex-none w-[340px] for the grey background preview panel.
layouts.receipt_container: Centered in the right panel. Width animates between 220px (58mm) and 280px/300px (80mm). White background, jagged bottom edge via CSS or straight edge with shadow.

component_guidelines.tabs: Pill-style navigation. Container: bg-[#F3F4F6] p-1 rounded-lg. Active tab: bg-white shadow-sm text-dark-text. Inactive: text-gray-text hover:text-dark-text.
component_guidelines.radio_cards: Large clickable areas for Connection Types and Printing Modes. Use border-2 border-transparent, and when active: border-primary_orange bg-primary_orange/10.
component_guidelines.multi_select: Popover + Command pattern (Shadcn UI). Search input inside the popover to filter 30+ employees, with checkbox list below. Renders selected employees as chips inside the printer row.
component_guidelines.buttons: Save/Confirm = bg-[#329937] text-white hover:bg-[#2A8030]. Primary/Active actions = bg-[#F26B33]. Secondary/Cancel = border border-[#E5E7EB] bg-white text-[#6B7280].
component_guidelines.inputs: TextInput, SelectInput, ToggleSwitch. Must use exact constraint colors.

motion.transitions: Hover states on cards: translateY(-1px) with subtle shadow increase.
motion.receipt_toggle: Smooth width transition (transition-all duration-300 ease-out) when toggling between 58mm and 80mm preview widths.
motion.inline_expansion: Smooth height expansion for the inline forms to avoid jarring jumps.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence. Text on primary buttons must be #FFFFFF. Muted text must be #6B7280 against #FFFFFF to pass APCA.
accessibility.test_ids: CRITICAL: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements. Example: data-testid='printer-add-button', data-testid='tab-stations', data-testid='connection-type-usb'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update PrinterAgentConfigView to handle 6 tabs (Printers, Auto Print, Bill Content, Print Style, Printer Mapping, Stations).

CR-167: Implement 'Add/Edit Printer' entirely inline. When 'Add' is clicked, inject the form into the view. Use the large radio-button CARDS for USB/LAN/Bluetooth. Conditionally render fields based on connection type.
CR-160: Create the 'Printer Mapping' tab. Build the 'Edit Assignments' component using shadcn Popover + Command to handle 30+ employees without cluttering the UI.
CR-161: Add 'Stations' tab with an inline CRUD table. Add the 'Printing Mode' (Fixed/Waiter/Station) radio cards section to the top of the 'Printers' tab.
CR-169: Refactor 'Print Style' tab to a split-panel layout. Left side holds the existing settings, right side is exactly 340px wide, colored #E5E7EB, holding the white thermal receipt preview.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or standard `<input type='date'>`. Rely on Shadcn components, customized with the brand constraints.
Ensure all components use the EXACT hex codes specified (#F26B33, #329937, #1A1A1A, #6B7280, #E5E7EB, #F7F7F7, #FFFFFF).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight within constraints.
Do not apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern pill-shaped or sharp button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 💡, etc) for icons. Use proper SVG libraries like Lucide or Phosphor.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use solid background for headers, never full transparent if content scrolls under.
